subject: Realtime chat hangs + client retry storm during peak — immediate mitigation
messages:
From: Carlos Garcia <carlos.garcia@mediasyn.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mediasyn SRE <sre@mediasyn.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: Realtime sessions are hanging + 429 spike during rollout

Hey Michael —

We're seeing degraded behavior for our live chat feature since yesterday's feature rollout. Symptoms: many sessions enter a hung state where completions never return (client sees spinner) and our client SDK starts aggressive retrying. Our telemetry shows a brief but sharp spike in 429s and 5xx from your hosted endpoint around 14:30 PDT, then a cascade of client retries that amplified errors and kept sessions stuck.

Attached are a tail of our KV cache logs (customer-kvlog-tail.txt) and a metrics snapshot (metrics-snippet-20261101.png). We're running ~250 concurrent users on the new flow — normally we see <40 errors/s but at the peak we hit ~1.2k errors/s, primarily 429 then some 503s.

This is impacting our pilot cohort. We need immediate help: can you confirm root cause and an interim mitigation (we can route to different model or increase idle timeouts) while we coordinate a postmortem?

Thanks,
Carlos
Carlos Garcia
Lead Product Engineer — Mediasyn
phone: +1-415-555-0923

--
Attachments: customer-kvlog-tail.txt (text), metrics-snippet-20261101.png (image)

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Garcia <carlos.garcia@mediasyn.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 15:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Realtime sessions are hanging + 429 spike during rollout

Carlos —

Really sorry you're seeing this. Thanks for the logs and the metrics snapshot. I'm escalating this to eng and SRE now (cc'd Monica and Rishi). Initial asks to help us triage quickly:
- Can you paste a small snippet of the client retry logic (backoff settings) and confirm whether you're using the streaming or polling SDK?
- Do you have a request id from one of the 503/429 responses (x-redwood-request-id) — if not we can correlate by timestamp and model name.

Immediate mitigation options we can flip from our side (low-friction):
1) Temporarily route your traffic to a compatible model variant with higher concurrency headroom.
2) Bump the streaming idle keepalive on your tenancy to 60s (currently set to 15s) to avoid premature client disconnects.
3) Apply a short client-side retry-smoothing recommendation (we can send a snippet) to break synchronized retries.

I'll keep you posted in this thread — sending to eng now.

Regards,
Michael Grant
Enterprise Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 16:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Realtime sessions are hanging + 429 spike during rollout

Team — forwarding Mediasyn thread. Symptoms look like: spike of upstream 429s -> client retry storm -> idle stream disconnects -> more cold starts and 5xx under pressure.

Quick notes from initial triage:
- The customer's metrics show burst concurrency ~250; our model variant currently assigned to their tenancy is a higher-latency but tightly batched variant (q8) tuned for throughput, not low-latency conversational workloads.
- We saw a regional CDN networking blip at ~14:27 PDT (observability event INF-4521) that correlated with increased prefix cache misses. That could have caused transient latency, triggering client-side timeouts.

Immediate action I'd propose (we should pick 1 and act now):
A) Swap them to the lower-batched, lower-latency model variant (mv-faster-1) — reduces batching efficiency but improves P95 latency.
B) Increase per-tenant streaming keepalive to 60s and enable per-session token-level caching to reduce upstream cold-starts.

Rishi: can you take point on performing the model swap and watching 429 rate? Laura: please prepare a short external status note for Carlos with exactly what we changed. Michael, can you confirm customer consent for a short zero-downtime reroute?

--
Monica

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Carlos Garcia <carlos.garcia@mediasyn.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 01:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Realtime sessions are hanging + 429 spike during rollout

Carlos / Team —

We performed an emergency, zero-downtime reroute at 00:45 PDT and moved Mediasyn traffic from mv-q8-heavy to mv-faster-1 for the conversation route. Early telemetry: 429 rate dropped ~85% within 5 minutes and P95 latency improved from ~2.9s to ~720ms. We also increased streaming idle keepalive for the tenancy to 60s.

What we changed (for the record):
- Model variant swap: mv-q8-heavy -> mv-faster-1 (no customer code change)
- Tenant streaming keepalive: 15s -> 60s
- Enabled session-level KV caching (short TTL) to reduce cold-starts for identical prefixes

Next steps we need from Mediasyn: please deploy a client-side retry smoothing (exponential jitter) — if you want, we can PR a small snippet. Also, if you can share a representative request id next time it happens, we will correlate traces immediately.

We will keep this change for the next 48 hours while we validate stability during Mediasyn's peak hours; revert back optionally after that.

Laura: please send the external status summary to Carlos. Monica: I'll monitor infra alerts and open INF-4521 for postmortem.

-Rishi

Carlos —

Quick status update and exactly what we changed (no action required on your side unless you want the retry snippet):
- Performed zero-downtime route swap to mv-faster-1 at 00:45 PDT.
- Increased your tenancy streaming idle keepalive to 60s to reduce idle disconnects.
- Enabled short TTL session KV caching to reduce upstream model cold starts.

Observed impact: 429 errors dropped ~85% and client-visible hang reports have fallen to near baseline. We will keep these settings for 48 hours to validate.

Suggested client change (optional but recommended): switch to exponential backoff with jitter and cap retries to 3 for streaming completions. Example snippet:

setTimeout(() => {
  // exponential backoff + jitter pseudo
  const base = Math.pow(2, attempt) * 200 + Math.random() * 100;
}, attempt);

If you'd like we can open a short joint session to walk through the client change.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: repro-steps.md

Thanks — we saw the drop immediately after the change. P95 is back under 1s for our traffic and the pilot cohort is no longer reporting hangs. We'll implement the exponential jitter snippet and throttle retries on our side tomorrow morning.

Appreciate the quick action — Carlos
